LanguageData.LP_AberrantTumor.label: aberrant growth
LanguageData.LP_AberrantTumor.description: A lump of extra flesh left by aberrant regenerative paste that twitches slightly on its own. Doesn't hurt or itch, just ugly. Can be surgically removed.
LanguageData.LP_MorphDraught.label: metamorphosis
LanguageData.LP_MorphDraught.description: Muscles bulge outward, and the face is warping along with them. Melee damage +20%, pain threshold +20%, social impact -30%.
LanguageData.LP_FarRealmSated.label: Far Realm satiation
LanguageData.LP_FarRealmSated.description: The ghoul swallowed twisted meat, and the Far Realm flesh churns in its stomach. Melee damage +10%, move speed +5%.
LanguageData.LP_FleshMinion.label: hatched fleshbeast
LanguageData.LP_FleshMinion.description: A small fleshbeast that crawled out of a flesh incubator (or an aberrant golem's remains), obeying the colony and rotting when its time is up.
LanguageData.LP_AberrantGolem.label: aberrant flesh
LanguageData.LP_AberrantGolem.description: This flesh golem is mixed with twisted meat from the Far Realm: tougher (damage taken -17%, equivalent to +20% health), wounds slowly heal on their own; when it dies it splits into 2 small fleshbeasts that rot after 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_FleshNourished.label: twisted meat nourishment
LanguageData.LP_FleshNourished.description: Fed 5 twisted meat today. Work efficiency +10%.
